words.intro: Your appointments in Apple Calendar, Google Calendar or Outlook, kept up to date on their own. Bookings, moves and cancellations show up there without you doing anything.
words.heading: What goes into it
points: Your own appointments from the last month and the next four: the time, the service and a short name — “Skin fade · Ada N.”
Never a phone number, an email, a price, a note or anything from a health record. Tap an event to open the full appointment here, behind your sign-in.
Calendars check for changes on their own schedule — every 30 minutes or so on an iPhone, and every few hours on Google Calendar. For something booked in the last hour, look here.
words.careful: Anyone with the link can see what is in it, so treat it like a key. If it ends up somewhere it should not, make a new one or stop sharing.
